name: uno-arena
description: UNO Arena - real-time multiplayer UNO-style card game (Angular 20 + Node.js + Socket.IO + JSON Server)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @uno-arena/server && npm run build --workspace @uno-arena/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @uno-arena/server && npm run test --workspace @uno-arena/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @uno-arena/server && npm run lint --workspace @uno-arena/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @uno-arena/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @uno-arena/web
